column1: #   name        short key for `./fetch <name>` and `./boot.py --ini ini/<name>.ini`
#   urls        space-separated list of URLs to download (relative to the image dir)
#   boot        console boot sequence for boot.py: SEND>EXPECT|SEND>EXPECT
#   cc          has the C compiler (cc/c0/c1/as/ld)?  yes/no
#   src         has the Unix source tree (/usr/src) on the image?  yes/no
# NOTE: no prebuilt bootable disk ships with /usr/src.  The compiler is present
# on the bootable images; the full source tree is distributed separately (the
# Keith Bostic V7 tape, or the pcollinson/narukeh git trees).  "cc+src" is
# achieved by combining a bootable disk with the source tape.
